instructions.purpose: Search the public web for current or external information that is not available in the conversation context.

tool.name: web-search
tool.description: Searches Tavily and returns result titles, URLs, content summaries, and relevance scores. Empty results are allowed and mean no relevant result was found by the search endpoint.

usage_rules.rule: Use this only when the user needs current, external, or source-backed information.
Do not use it for simple conversation, internal memory recall, or facts already present in context.
Prefer a focused query and maxResults of 3-5 unless the user asks for broader research.
Use topic news for news queries, finance for finance/market queries, and general otherwise.
Use timeRange only when freshness matters: day, week, month, or year.
Use web-fetch afterward only when result content is needed to answer accurately.
If the tool fails because of authentication, quota, or service errors, do not retry the same search. Explain briefly that search was unavailable.

example.context: User asks: "What changed in Bun this week?"
User asks: "How do I use the Discord.js Client class?"
